prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `order(nodes, edges)` in src/lib.rs for a directed graph with nodes `0..nodes`. Each edge `(from, to)` means `from` must come before `to`. Return a topological order that always picks the smallest available node first, or `None` if an edge is out of range or the graph has a cycle. Duplicate edges count once. An empty graph returns an empty vector. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
